ARKFLAME STUDIOS / BROWSER TOOLS

GLOBAL DOM OPTIMIZER VERSION 0.0.6

A cleaner,
faster web.

Long chats, articles, feeds and docs should stay responsive. Global DOM Optimizer helps Chromium skip rendering eligible content outside the viewport, without removing it from the page.

Download v0.0.6 ZIP How it works ↗

For Chromium and Helium · Manual installation (unpacked) · Chrome Web Store listing pending

✓ Automatic containment ✓ On-device processing ✓ Per-site control

HOW IT WORKS

Less work beyond what you see.

Content stays in the document. Eligible sections far from view skip layout and painting until you scroll near them.

01

Detect independent blocks

Finds eligible paragraphs, messages, articles, code and image sections, even inside nested scrollers.

02

Skip offscreen rendering

Uses native content-visibility containment. It doesn't delete nodes or rewrite the site.

03

Restore content on approach

Viewport checks and cached scan regions bring nearby elements back as you scroll.

BUILT FOR REAL PAGES

Quietly useful. Fully in control.

▤

Long-form content

Built for long AI chats, documents, tutorials and image-heavy feeds.

▦

Incremental scanning

Tracks structural changes in cached regions. It doesn't rescan the whole page after each update.

◎

Live diagnostics

See managed blocks, offscreen coverage estimates, scan counts and local scan work.

◇

Your choice per website

One automatic strategy, a global switch and a per-site on/off switch.

GET STARTED

Install in under a minute.

Download and unzip the extension. Open chrome://extensions in your Chromium-based browser, turn on Developer mode, and pick Load unpacked.

Download the extension ZIP ↓

Designed to be safe, not magical.

Results vary by site and device. Interactive elements may be left alone. Less rendering work doesn't guarantee better FPS, CPU or RAM. The percentage in the extension estimates scroll-height coverage. It is not a benchmark.
